Database.//: Provider selects the EF Core backend: 'SqlServer' (default) or 'PostgreSQL'. The ConnectionStrings:AgriERP value must match the chosen provider.

JwtSettings.//: Key must be at least 32 characters - HMAC-SHA256 needs 256 bits. The API refuses to start otherwise. Replace this before any non-local deployment.

DataGovIn.//: Free API key from data.gov.in for Agmarknet mandi prices. Leave blank to disable the mandi widget. Put the real key in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) or the DataGovIn__ApiKey env var - never commit it.
